overall_goal: Add garam masala, salt, and green peas to the cooker and stir

goals.description: Add garam masala to the cooker and stir
goals.rationale: The person positions the ingredients, transfers the garam masala powder into the pressure cooker, and stirs the mixture.

goals.description: Add salt to the cooker and stir
goals.rationale: The person opens the salt jar, retrieves a spoon from the drawer, adds salt to the pressure cooker, and stirs the contents.

goals.description: Add green peas to the cooker and stir
goals.rationale: The person transfers green peas from a bowl into the pressure cooker and thoroughly stirs the ingredients together.
